curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach tire checks, then seating position, then mirror settings and clear glass
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on tire checks, seating, mirrors and glass
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on monthly checks, seating gaps and mirror settings

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the belt law and why belts work, then proper belt position, then how air bags supplement belts and the rear-facing rule
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on belt law, belt position, air bag timing and seating distance
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on belt law, belt placement and air bag rules

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the height thresholds for restraints and boosters, then anchoring and fitting help
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on restraint and booster thresholds and penalties
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on height limits, booster ages and fitting help

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach what a secure load means, then how to tie cargo down, then the limits of assistance technology
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on load security and assistance tech limits
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on secure loads and driver engagement with assistance tech
